biography: I am a mechanical engineering academic and technology entrepreneur based in Kano, Nigeria. My work connects computational design, digital manufacturing, engineering education, and the development of practical digital systems. At Bayero University, Kano, I serve as Lecturer I in Mechanical Engineering, Head of the CAD/CAM Laboratory, and Deputy Director of the Centre for Distance Learning. I also lead Voostech, bringing together software development and technology education.
teachingStatement: I teach engineering drawing, computer applications, mechanisms, and finite element methods. My teaching combines foundational principles with practical exercises and engineering software, helping students connect analytical ideas with the tasks they will encounter in engineering practice.
researchThemes: AI and machine learning in engineering design and analysis
